debut.text: I first met Rachel and her husband on a holiday trip to Australia, where she began to tell me the plot of 'Do Rabbits Eat Marshmallows.' That instant, I had to place an order for the book so that it would be at my home after the trip. The minute I started reading it, I was drawn in. I could relate to all of the characters. I knew what they looked like, I knew their personalities. I knew each and every one of them. Rachel's writing is from the heart. It places you in each scene, not as a participant, but as one who is observing everything that is taking place. Buy the book. Don't try to read it all at once, there is too much happening. Read it over time and think about everything that is taking place. It is a superb novel.
debut.author: Steve

debut.text:
I really appreciated the gently imperfect characters and the emphasis on living with loss instead of "moving beyond" it. Also the patience that is so necessary when sitting in discomfort and awkwardness that are so much a part of caring relationships. It was thoughtful how you wove in "chosen family" as the ones who often modeled curiosity, calm and deep listening as a way through grief towards healing.

Thank you - a gift.
debut.author: Nansi

debut.text:
I really enjoyed your book. I very much related to the pain, guilt and forgiveness experienced by your wonderful characters. Even though I cried I also found the story uplifting and full of hope and love. In some ways cathartic. The characters felt very real to me and that was down to your writing, story telling and knowledge of the subject.

I loved the way the rabbit and marshmallows entwined through the story.
debut.author: Linda

debut.text: I give 5 stars to DO RABBITS EAT MARSHMALLOWS because I enjoyed the story, in spite of some tears. The characters are interesting people in a contemporary extended family. It is a heartwarming and uplifting story. I would certainly recommend giving it a read!
debut.author: Susie

debut.text: I took this book on holiday with me and was always eager to read it each day to find out what would happen next in the lives of all the different characters. The little details in the story brings the characters to life in a way that you feel part of their journey. Lots of highs and lows in a well written, emotional novel.
debut.author: Ruth

debut.text: Really enjoyed this book. Once I started, I just couldn't put it down. It was very well written and so true to life.
debut.author: Llanfair

debut.text:
In a world of hatred and discord, it was lovely to read such a family orientated book. It was extremely moving, showing true family situations, warts and all, but with ultimate happiness.

I loved every chapter even though I shed a few tears.

Brilliantly written portraying real family life and the creation of life.

Well done the author.
debut.author: Peter
